decisions.reason: The Hero V refinements do not alter the requirement that the second V derive from shared Hero V geometry; its existing relational state remains valid without modification.
The source changes only the Hero V arm and vertex character and does not modify the deferred E and L construction requirements.
The É accent's requirement to derive from Hero V geometry remains valid; the source does not change that derivation relationship or specify new accent behavior.
The source concerns black-and-white Hero V geometry exploration and does not change the deferred champagne material direction or its application constraint.
Changes to the Hero V's arm and vertex character do not alter the deferred wordmark spacing and cohesive-reading requirements.
The Hero V design decision is unrelated to accessible preview-image delivery formats.
